The combination of her lecture style, accent, and the fact that she assumes we all have the math prereqs means the lectures make no sense whatsoever and she can't explain

reviews.comment: Good professor. She teaches to teach instead of to challenge or test necessarily. The final exam was the only test and was quite hard, but due to the structure of the course, I did not need a high grade on the final to get an A, and neither did most students in the class. Attending lectures is not required but extremely useful. Ask her questions.
